payload.purpose_context: The glossary surface distinguishes a term link from an ordinary link only visually today, so assistive-technology users cannot perceive the difference. Two byte-identical link builders are kept in sync only by discipline plus a parity test, and the popover's caret/viewport-flip positioning has no automated regression guard. This mission closes those three follow-ups from the #64 glossary-term-ux review as one coherent slice on the glossary bounded context.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make glossary term links tell screen-reader users they are terms, guard the popover's positioning, and collapse two duplicate link builders into one.
